criteria.requirement: Implement cssselect.compiled.compile_selector(css, *, mode="xml", xhtml=False, prefix="descendant-or-self::") returning frozen CompiledSelector with canonical tuple, per-branch specificity tuple, XPath, mode, xhtml and prefix. Parse the complete real selector group once, never split literal commas, use actual selector_to_xpath with pseudo-element rejection and retain original exceptions. Support XML/HTML/XHTML casing and explicit prefixes, reject invalid mode/type combinations. Store no mutable parse tree or bound document and add no lxml runtime dependency; callers can evaluate the same XPath against multiple actual trees.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
